items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Big Sid was number one to my idea, really.

ctx.x: I only ask that... We're getting really out of context. I only ask that because you said "he wasn't one of my favorites," and I just thought who was your favorite. Well, those two drummers are fantastic.
Big Sid was number one to my idea, really.

Anyway, getting back to Ory and them, and Tudie... Well, there's no point in me asking you a whole lot about Tudie, because as I said, he's covered, and so is Blakeney on the Rutgers things that I did. And we've talked about Mutt. But Buster. Buster Wilson.
